t.p: This Privacy Policy explains how ("we", "us", "our") handles information in connection with our WhatsApp Cloud Connector application (the "App"), which lets a business send its own point-of-sale receipts to its customers over WhatsApp using the WhatsApp Business Cloud API provided by Meta.
t.h2: 1. Who is responsible for your data
t.p: The App is installed and operated by the business that uses it (the "Business") on its own systems. That Business is the data controller for the messages it sends and the contacts it stores. provides the software and acts as a data processor on the Business's behalf.

ul.li: Contact details — recipient names and WhatsApp phone numbers, taken from the Business's own records, used only to address a message.
Document content — the point-of-sale receipt that the Business chooses to send.
Message metadata — WhatsApp message IDs and delivery statuses (sent, delivered, read, failed) returned by Meta over a webhook.
API credentials — the Business's own WhatsApp phone number ID, WhatsApp Business Account ID and access token, stored so the App can send on the Business's behalf.

t.p: The App does not collect location data, browsing history, advertising identifiers, or any special-category personal data.

Information is used solely to deliver the message the Business requests, to record its delivery status, and to keep the connection to WhatsApp working. We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it for advertising or profiling.

To deliver a message, the recipient's phone number and the message content are sent to Meta Platforms, Inc. through the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Meta's handling of that data is governed by the WhatsApp Business Terms and Meta's own privacy policy. We do not share your data with any other third party except where required by law.

Message records and delivery statuses are kept within the Business's own Odoo database for as long as the Business needs them for its business and accounting records, and are deleted according to the Business's retention settings. Access tokens are kept only while the integration is active.
Data is stored inside the Business's own Odoo instance and transmitted to WhatsApp over encrypted HTTPS connections. Access credentials are restricted to authorised users of the Business's system.

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete the personal data held about you. As the data is held by the Business that messaged you, please direct such requests to that Business, or contact us and we will help route the request. See our Data Deletion instructions.
The App is a business tool and is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). We do not knowingly process such data.
We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent change.
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the WhatsApp Cloud Connector application (the "App") provided by ("we", "us"). By installing or using the App you agree to these Terms.
The App integrates an Odoo system with the WhatsApp Business Cloud API so that a business can send its own point-of-sale receipts to its customers, and receive delivery statuses.

ul.li: You must have a valid WhatsApp Business Account and comply with the WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy and all applicable laws.
You may only message recipients who have a lawful basis or opt-in to receive your messages, and you must honour opt-out requests.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the content you send and for keeping your API credentials secure.

t.p: You must not use the App to send spam, unlawful, misleading, or abusive content, or to violate the rights of any person or the policies of Meta / WhatsApp.

The App depends on third-party services (Meta / WhatsApp Cloud API and your own Odoo hosting). We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability and are not responsible for outages of those third-party services.

The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the App, including undelivered messages.
We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
This page explains how to request deletion of personal data processed by the WhatsApp Cloud Connector application ("App") provided by .

The App may store a recipient's name and WhatsApp phone number, the documents sent to them, and the delivery status of those messages. This data is held inside the Odoo database of the business that sent the message.
To have your personal data deleted, send a request to us and we will action it, or route it to the business that messaged you, within 30 days:

ol.li: Email with the subject line "Data Deletion Request".
Include the WhatsApp phone number that received the messages so we can locate the records.
We will confirm the identity of the requester where required, delete the associated personal data, and send you a confirmation once complete.

t.p: If you are the business operating the App, you can delete this data directly in Odoo by removing the relevant contact and WhatsApp message records, and by revoking the stored access token on the WhatsApp account configuration.
